embeds.title: 👋 Welcome to {server}, {username}!
embeds.description: Here's everything you need to get going. Only you can see this — press the button again any time to bring it back.

fields.name: 📈 Leveling & XP
fields.value:
`/daily` — claim daily XP; claiming on consecutive days builds a streak with bigger rewards.
`/levels rank` — your level, XP and server rank.
`/levels leaderboard` — the server’s XP leaderboard.
`/levels card` — change your rank card’s colour, background and tagline.

fields.name: 🧰 Game tools
fields.value:
`/calculate` — what it costs to reach your pet, gun or fish goal.
`/guide view · list · search` — open, list or search the guides.

fields.name: 🛍️ Spending XP
fields.value:
`/shop view` · `/shop buy` — browse and buy items.
`/shop inventory` — see what you own.
`/gamble coinflip · dice · limbo · blackjack · mines · highlow` — the XP games.
`/gamble info` — payouts, and how many plays and XP you have left today.
`/pot view` — today’s Daily XP Pot.
`/idle play` — the Bubble Factory idle game (no gambling).

fields.name: 🧭 Everyday
fields.value:
`/remind me` — DM yourself a reminder, e.g. in 2h.
`/birthday set` — save your birthday.
`/music play` — lofi radio in your voice channel.
`/userinfo` · `/avatar` · `/serverinfo` — info about a member or the server.
`/loof help` — every command.
